title: kernel-v1 benchmark run evidence (v1)
description: One benchmark-run row in the kernel-v1 reproducibility ledger. Captures the frozen-agent anti-limiter control, the environment hashes (kernel release, BTF, toolchain, image digest), the raw and report artifact digests, the published p99 latency and throughput numbers with confidence-interval bounds, and the gate decision the bench gate script produced. Reviewers MUST reject any run that lacks an env_hash or whose frozen_agent_run_id cannot be re-derived.

schema_version.description: Bumped on backward-incompatible shape changes. Currently always 1.

runs.description: Per-workload, per-mode run records. Each run binds the workload id, mode tag, raw CSV digest, report markdown digest, environment hash, the published latency/throughput/loss numbers with confidence-interval bounds, the pass/fail per gate, and the frozen-agent control run id.

raw_csv_sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the raw CSV artifact.

report_md_sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the report.md artifact.

env_hash.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the environment manifest (kernel release + btf_sha256 + toolchain versions + image digest).

p99_ci_upper_ns.description: Upper bound of the published confidence interval for p99 latency, in nanoseconds.

throughput_bps.description: Measured throughput in bytes per second.

throughput_ci_lower_bps.description: Lower bound of the published confidence interval for throughput, in bytes per second.

loss_pct.description: Measured loss percentage (0..100). Critical synthetic loss MUST be 0 inside the published supported-load envelope; outside it must show nonzero drops.

pass_fail.description: True iff the run satisfies its per-gate thresholds (sub-5% p99 latency increase, sub-5% throughput decrease, supported-loss envelope).

frozen_agent_run_id.description: Run identifier of the matching frozen-agent anti-limiter control. Reviewers use this to prove the workload was not the limiter.

anti_limiter_demonstrated.description: True iff at least one frozen-agent anti-limiter run is recorded in `runs` and its p99 latency is at or below the per-workload published bound. Reviewers MUST be able to point at the row by frozen_agent_run_id.

env.description: Environment manifest. Reviewers use this to reproduce the run.

kernel_release.description: Kernel release string the run executed on (`uname -r`).

btf_sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of /sys/kernel/btf/vmlinux the run executed against.

toolchain_versions.description: Pinned toolchain versions: clang, bpftool, libbpf, rustc. Free-form so reviewers see the lock state of every component.

image_digest.description: OCI image digest (sha256:...) the run executed in. Must be a content-addressed digest, never a mutable tag.

gate_decision.description: Aggregate bench gate decision for this evidence row. 'pass' iff every run in `runs` has pass_fail==true. 'fail' otherwise.

resume_bullet_published.description: True iff the 'sub-5% p99 latency and throughput overhead' resume bullet was published for this run. Reviewers MUST verify resume_bullet_published==false whenever gate_decision=='fail'; publishing the bullet on a failed gate is a must-NOT-have violation.
